method: Native Windows Chrome UI observation and input
scope: Overview, property register and property dialog at native 200% and 400% browser zoom

checks.actual: Native menu and accessibility tree reported Zoom: 200%.
Heading, metrics, Refresh and Add property remained visible; navigation used the mobile disclosure.

checks.expected: 200% property dialog can be read and dismissed
checks.actual: Dialog labels were exposed; its scrollbar reached rent/status and Save/Cancel; Cancel closed the form.
Native accessibility tree reported Zoom: 400%, using browser zoom controls, not CSS zoom or a smaller emulated viewport.

checks.expected: 400% navigation can be used with keyboard
checks.actual: Opened menu; Tab showed Overview then Properties with visible focus and scrolling; Enter opened Properties.
Scrolled to search, typed Abbeyhills, observed Showing 1 of 8 properties; Clear filters restored Showing 8 of 8.
Tab traversed postcode, bedrooms, rent, occupancy, Cancel and Save, scrolling focused controls into view. Empty Save returned focus to address and displayed a text error.

checks.expected: Dialog dismissal and browser restoration work
checks.actual: Escape closed the invalid form; focus returned to Add property. Browser exited fullscreen and its native zoom alert showed 100%.

limits: Not an independent learner or participant session
No Narrator/NVDA speech heard or verified
No actual OS contrast mode or physical touch device test
privacy: Evidence screenshots capture only the website in browser fullscreen. Unrelated browser chrome and account/bookmark details are excluded.
